summary: Americas Gold and Silver Corporation filed a Form 6-K on July 23, 2026, announcing second-quarter production results. The company reported consolidated silver production of 665,000 ounces, lead production of 2.3 million pounds, copper production of 850,000 pounds, and antimony production of 97,000 pounds. It also disclosed an unaudited cash balance of US$89 million as of June 30, 2026. The report includes operational updates on the Galena Complex modernization program but contains no transaction, no special-situation event, and no news outside routine operational disclosure. This is a standard periodic filing by a foreign private issuer.
